result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): B keeps the lend flow visible: tools, member, an editable Due back date picker and a clear Lend tools button with guidance in its empty state. Its wording is mostly consistent, though the due date isn't labeled as a default. A presents 3/7/14-day loan lengths with 7 preselected, which looks like an invented policy; it also mixes borrower, member, late and overdue, and its confirm action is cut off below the panel. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): A keeps its terms consistent (member, tool, due back) and uses an editable due-back date instead of a fixed loan rule, though it doesn't label that date as a default. B mixes in 'borrower', 'free', 'late' and 'loan length', and its 3/7/14-day buttons with 7 days pre-selected read like an invented policy. Both are focused desk screens with Lend out and Take back tabs, but neither screenshot shows the member-not-found, already-out or nothing-lent messages.
